penalties.details: A penalty under section 274 read with section 271FA of Income Tax Act, 1961 of Rs. 4,60,000 was imposed on the Company for delayed filing of Statement of Financial Transaction Return under Income Tax Act for FY 2022-23 for Dividend declared by the Company for the FY 2022-23. The Company had filed NIL Statement of Financial Transaction Return for FY 2022-23 on 29 May 2023 within stipulated timeframe believing that only Dividend Income received by the Company is required to reported under section 285BA(1) of Income Tax Act, 1961 and not Dividend paid. Upon receipt of notice from Income Tax department, the Company was made aware that Statement of Financial Transaction Return is required to be filed for Dividend paid too, post which the Company filed updated Statement of Financial Transaction Return for FY 2022-23 on 29 November 2024. The Company has paid penalty on 23 February 2026.
penalties.impact: There is no material impact on the financial position or operation of the Company due to the said penalty.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had received an Order from the Additional Commissioner, GST & Central Excise, Mumbai East Commissionerate, imposing a Tax Demand of Rs. 22,40,46,313/- and a penalty of Rs. 22,40,46,313/- with respect to GST assessment for the six financial years commencing from FY 2018-19 to FY 2023-24 under applicable provisions of the Maharashtra GST Act 2017, CGST Act 2017 and IGST Act 2017. The Order was received on account of certain vendors erroneously tagging services under the Reverse Charge Mechanism (‘RCM’) instead of it being exempted services under the aforesaid Acts, while filing GSTR-1 Returns for the respective period, thereby resulting into alleged demand of GST under the said RCM and levy of penalty on the Company.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Additional Commissioner, GST & Central Excise, Mumbai East Commissionerate
tax_litigation.status: The Additional Commissioner has considered the Company's submissions and supporting documents, and dropped the proceedings vide its Order dated 30.04.2026. Thus, the case is disposed off and accordingly the Tax Demand of Rs. 22,40,46,313/- and a penalty of Rs. 22,40,46,313/- has also been disposed off.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,791.41 Cr (+14.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹20.19 Cr (against a loss of ₹6.75 Cr a year earlier).
Mahindra Logistics Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹2.50 per share (25%) for FY2026, subject to AGM approval on July 20, 2026, with record date July 10, 2026.
Mahindra Logistics reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹6,999 Cr and a net profit of ₹2.3 Cr, returning to profitability.
Mahindra Logistics hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on April 24, 2026, highlighting a return to annual PAT profitability and continued turnaround in its Express business.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,095.43 Cr (+24.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹26.25 Cr (against a loss of ₹10.35 Cr a year earlier).
Mahindra Logistics reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹2,095.43 Cr and net profit of ₹26.25 Cr, with Rivigo turning EBITDA-positive.
